name: telehealth-portal-microservices
description: Comprehensive HIPAA-Conscious Healthcare Portal Microservices Architecture

scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install && cd services/gateway && npm.cmd install && cd ../auth-service && npm.cmd install && cd ../signaling-service && npm.cmd install && cd ../ehr-service && npm.cmd install && cd ../vitals-service && npm.cmd install && cd ../../client && npm.cmd install
scripts.seed:all: node services/auth-service/src/seed.js && node services/ehr-service/src/seed.js && node services/vitals-service/src/seed.js && node services/signaling-service/src/seed.js
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,SIGNAL,EHR,VITALS,CLIENT" -c "magenta,blue,green,yellow,cyan,red" "npm.cmd run dev:gateway" "npm.cmd run dev:auth" "npm.cmd run dev:signaling" "npm.cmd run dev:ehr" "npm.cmd run dev:vitals" "npm.cmd run dev:client"
